bibl.title: Diode probes for spatiotemporal optical control of multiple neurons in freely moving animals

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: an instrument: independent optical control of many sites in the brain of a freely moving animal, with the stimulated neurons recorded at the same time
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: how to stimulate exactly the neurons being monitored, when electrodes hear only 60 μm and every existing light source reaches far further than that
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a diode-fiber assembly light enough to put one on every shank - local photostimulation and recording of the same cells, without light artifacts, spike superposition or a fiber tether
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: method
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: multisite optogenetic control of neurons in freely moving animals
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Putting the fiber tip within tens of μm of the recording sites means very little light is needed, which in turn removes the need for high currents and lets the device avoid heat sinks, optical artifacts and spike superposition while confining the effect to the monitored neurons
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: An index-matched glue at the diode–fiber interface cuts Fresnel reflection losses and widens the fiber's acceptance angle for skew rays, which is why coupled power doubles
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Red-light-driven halorhodopsin hyperpolarisation of the membrane delays the ChR2-evoked spike, which is why latencies lengthen when activation and silencing are applied together
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The unusually high fraction of responsive units follows from the high AAV transduction rate combined with the very short distance between fiber tip and recording sites
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the light is weak and the fiber tip is close, so the illuminated volume is about 0.001 mm 3 - the cells the light reaches are the cells the shank can hear
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a drop of index-matching glue at the diode-fiber interface, which cuts the reflective losses at each interface from 8% to under 1%
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the same glue admits skew rays from all directions, which is where the doubling in coupling efficiency actually comes from
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the light path perpendicular to the recording sites and the power several orders of magnitude below laser stimulation, so there are no local field potential artifacts to interpret
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The spatial confinement of the photostimulus is itself a drawback for experiments that need a whole structure controlled synchronously.
span.note: what this limits: the confinement that is the method's selling point: FOR SOME APPLICATIONS, THE USE OF SPATIALLY RESTRICTED PHOTOSTIMULATION FOR LOCALIZED NEURONAL CONTROL IS ACTUALLY A LIMITATION - an advantage for one use and a defect for another
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The 1/d scattering model used to estimate light intensity overestimates power beyond 1 mm from the fiber tip.
span.note: what this limits: every light-intensity figure beyond 1 mm from the tip: THE MODEL CONSISTENTLY OVERESTIMATED POWER AT DISTANCES >1 MM, while POWER AT SHORTER DISTANCES WAS WELL-APPROXIMATED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The fluorescein-bath measurement of the light cone is only an approximation of the real geometric light distribution in brain tissue.
span.note: what this limits: the measured light cone: THIS IS ONLY A PROXY TO THE REAL GEOMETRIC DISTRIBUTION OF LIGHT IN THE BRAIN SINCE SCATTERING MAY CONTRIBUTE ... ESPECIALLY AT SHORT WAVELENGTHS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE PAPER'S HEADLINE ADVANTAGE, RE-TAGGED AS A LIMITATION: spatially restricted photostimulation IS ACTUALLY A LIMITATION for experiments requiring synchronous control of an entire structure
span.note: what this limits: experiments requiring synchronous control of an entire structure, where the spatial extent should be two to three orders of magnitude higher than the 0.001 mm 3 a shank can monitor
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the scattering model consistently overestimated power beyond 1 mm, and scattering ran 5 to 10% higher in tissue that was not fresh
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 1, plus the tissue caveat: SCATTERING WAS SLIGHTLY HIGHER (5-10%) IN NONFRESH TISSUE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the fluorescein image is declared A PROXY ONLY for the real geometric distribution of light in the brain, since scattering contributes to it at short wavelengths
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[2] · what this limits: the same scope as item 2 - the fluorescein image stands in for the real distribution
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the high fraction of light-modulated units MAY BE DUE TO transduction rates and the proximity of the fiber tip rather than to anything general
span.note: what this limits: the fraction of units reported as light-modulated: it MAY BE DUE TO THE HIGH ChR2 TRANSDUCTION RATES ... AND THE PROXIMITY OF THE FIBER TIP TO THE RECORDING SITES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the count of illuminated cells rests on an assumed neuronal density and IGNORES SHADOWING by the probe shank
span.note: what this limits: the count of illuminated cells: THE ESTIMATION ... ASSUMES NEURONAL DENSITY OF 20,000 CELLS/MM3 AND IGNORES SHADOWING BY THE PROBE SHANK
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the number of fibers a freely moving animal can be tethered to limited to one or two, which RESTRICTED the range of scientific questions that could be addressed
span.note: what this limits: what could be asked before this method, not only what could be measured: SINCE THE NUMBER OF FIBERS A FREELY MOVING ANIMAL CAN BE TETHERED TO IS LIMITED (1-2 FOR SMALL RODENTS), THE RANGE OF SCIENTIFIC QUESTIONS THAT COULD BE ADDRESSED WAS RESTRICTED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: for a uniform planar (Lambertian) light source and a straight cleaved optical fiber having a numerical aperture, the maximum coupling efficiency of Hudson 1974
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: reflective losses, quantified by the Fresnel equations at each interface, and skew rays - two factors with opposing practical implications, both ignored in the standard coupling formula
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a 1/d scattering model fitted to power measured through a block of brain, giving a scattering coefficient per wavelength
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: red laser diodes driven by similar currents, yielding light at the fiber tip that subtended a similar illuminated volume of brain tissue
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: waveguides embedded in the probe shank, named as the route to scaling the number of sources
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: closed-loop triggering - the recorded signal decides when the stimulus happens
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: spike waveforms during light compared with waveforms during spontaneous activity
span.note: eliminates: the light distorting or superimposing the spikes it evokes - median waveform consistencies 0.977 against 0.983, U test P = 0.19
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: units recorded on the shanks that were NOT illuminated, 200 μm and further away
span.note: eliminates: the effect spreading beyond the illuminated shank - 52% modulated on the lit shank against 6.8% nearby, at chance level by an exact binomial test
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the same cross-correlation histograms computed over a duration-matched baseline period before any stimulation
span.note: eliminates: the correlations being native rather than induced - the baseline histograms were nearly flat WITH AN EXCEPTION, a 1-ms lag between the units on shanks 4 and 3
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the wideband traces inspected for photoelectrical artifacts at the light powers actually used
span.note: eliminates: light artifacts masquerading as physiology - the weak stimulus produced no LFP artifacts, unlike powers three orders of magnitude higher
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the scattering fit repeated across tip morphology, source power and brain region
span.note: eliminates: the attenuation constant depending on how it was measured - it did not, EXCEPT that scattering was 5 to 10% higher in nonfresh tissue and the model overestimates beyond 1 mm
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE PAPER'S HEADLINE ADVANTAGE, RE-TAGGED AS A LIMITATION BY ITS OWN AUTHORS: for some applications the use of SPATIALLY RESTRICTED PHOTOSTIMULATION for localized neuronal control IS ACTUALLY A LIMITATION - where synchronous control of an entire structure is wanted, the spatial extent should be two to three ORDERS OF MAGNITUDE HIGHER than the 0.001 mm 3 that can be monitored
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the resolution is not a better setting but a different question - THE SPECIFIC LIGHT SOURCES AND FIBERS SHOULD BE TAILORED TO THE SCIENTIFIC QUESTION AT HAND
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ONE INTERVENTION, TWO COMPONENTS, OPPOSITE SIGNS: the index-matching glue reduces reflective losses considerably, to under 1%, BUT AT A COST OF REDUCING the effective acceptance angle of the fiber BY 41%
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the same glue on the other component: its effect on the SKEW RAYS acceptance angle is DIAMETRICALLY OPPOSITE from its effect on the meridional one, enabling acceptance from all directions and A TWOFOLD INCREASE in coupling efficiency - the net sign is empirical, not derivable
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the two ignored factors named as ignored: TWO FACTORS, WHICH HAVE OPPOSING PRACTICAL IMPLICATIONS, WERE IGNORED IN THE FOREGOING - reflective losses, and skew rays
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A MEASURED CONSTANT THAT DISAGREES WITH THE PUBLISHED ONE, AND THE DISAGREEMENT DECLARED NOT TO MATTER: blue-light scattering 7.18 against a previously reported 10.3 for rat brain, explained by the slightly different testing conditions - and IN ANY EVENT estimates were SIMILAR REGARDLESS OF THE PRECISE NUMBER USED
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the model's own failure stated with its range: it CONSISTENTLY OVERESTIMATED power beyond 1 mm while fitting well below it, and scattering was 5 to 10% higher in nonfresh tissue
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the empirical map declared a proxy: THIS IS ONLY A PROXY to the real geometric distribution of light in the brain, since scattering may contribute, ESPECIALLY AT SHORT WAVELENGTHS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: WHY THE LIGHT HAS TO BE WEAK AND CLOSE: electrodes can only disambiguate spikes of neurons up to 60 μm away, so stimulating from the surface or from a fiber a few hundred μm off INEVITABLY ACTIVATES MANY MORE UNMONITORED NEURONS THAN ARE BEING MONITORED, MAKING THE SEPARATION BETWEEN DIRECT AND POPULATION-MEDIATED EFFECTS IMPOSSIBLE
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and strong light of ANY wavelength carries energy dissipated as HEAT, which has a MIXED DE-/HYPERPOLARIZING effect - a confound that does not depend on the opsin at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE SAME LIGHT, THE OPPOSITE SIGN, DECIDED BY THE PROMOTER: identical parameters in CA1 give robust spiking of pyramidal cells in CaMKII::ChR2 mice, and in PV::ChR2 mice spiking of interneurons FOLLOWED BY SILENCING of the nearby pyramidal cells
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A 25% CHANGE IN DOSE FLIPS THE OUTCOME: 70% of the 0.35 mW/mm 2 blue pulses overcame the red-light hyperpolarization but ONLY 10% of the 0.28 mW/mm 2 pulses did - the same two opsins, the same cells, and a sharp threshold between activation and silencing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a statistical definition rescued by the data's own shape: the definition of light-modulated spiking WAS STATISTICAL, but the modulation indices exhibited a BIMODAL distribution, 0.045 against 0.76
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the fraction itself hedged - the relatively high fraction MAY BE DUE TO high transduction rates and the proximity of the fiber tip
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE UNIT IS DEFINED BY THREE NUMBERED GATES BEFORE ANY RESULT IS COMPUTED: peak-to-peak amplitude above 50 microvolts, L ratio below 0.05, and a clear refractory period - and then a fourth for the statistics, at least 100 spikes above 0.01 spikes/s
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: an idealisation declared inside a figure legend: the estimate ASSUMES neuronal density of 20,000 cells/mm 3 and IGNORES SHADOWING by the probe shank
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the temporal resolution stated as three numbers that mean different things - center-of-mass 12 ms, latency 5.5 ms, and precision, the across-trial SD, 2 ms
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE INSTRUMENT'S PURPOSE IS A DEBATE: spatiotemporally sequenced activity at different timescales COULD ADDRESS THE DEBATE ON RATE VS. TEMPORAL CODING - the same debate Levi2022 would later call rooted in definitions
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the synthetic pattern is taken up by the native one: units driven by nonperiodic photostimuli exhibited PHASE PRECESSION, indicating that NATIVE NETWORK DYNAMICS CAN INCORPORATE SYNTHETIC PATTERNS OF ACTIVITY
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critiques → stimulation from the brain surface or from large fibers hundreds of μm away, which activates far more neurons than are monitored
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS THE MISMATCH BETWEEN THE RECORDED AND THE ILLUMINATED VOLUME. 'SUCH ELECTRODES CAN ONLY RECORD AND DISAMBIGUATE SPIKES OF NEARBY (UP TO 60 UM) NEURONS, [so] STIMULATION OF CONTINUOUSLY MONITORED CELLS REQUIRES PLACING THE LIGHT SOURCE VERY CLOSE TO THE RECORDING SITE.' The recording radius is given as a number and the stimulated volume is larger - so a causal claim from optogenetics rests on cells that were driven and never observed. Q-509.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critiques → large-core fibers driven by strong light sources, which add heat, photoelectrical artifacts and synchronous activation
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS HEAT AS A CONFOUND OF THE LIGHT ITSELF. 'Quotation withheld.' The control for an optogenetic manipulation is light, and light is not inert - the confound is a property of the energy delivered, so it is present in every experiment of this kind at sufficient power. Q-509.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: distinguishes-from → small-core fibers coupled to lasers at low power, which solved the artifact problem but not the tether limit of one to two fibers
span.note: differs in: THE AXIS IS THE TETHER LIMIT, GIVEN AS A NUMBER. 'THESE ISSUES WERE PREVIOUSLY ADDRESSED IN PART BY COUPLING SMALL-CORE FIBERS TO DPSS LASERS DRIVEN AT LOW POWER, BUT SINCE THE NUMBER OF FIBERS A FREELY MOVING ANIMAL CAN BE TETHERED TO IS LIMITED (1-2 FOR SMALL RODENTS), THE RANGE OF SCIENTIFIC QUESTIONS THAT COULD BE ADDRESSED WAS RESTRICTED.' The earlier solution is credited with fixing the artifact and charged with a different limit - so the two are not better and worse, they fail at different points. Q-498.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (CONTAINMENT REVERSED, AND THE SPAN SPELLS THE DIRECTION OUT WITH A POSSESSIVE) · silicon probe —part-of→ shank
span.note: RETRACTED: CONTAINMENT REVERSED, AND THE SPAN SPELLS THE DIRECTION OUT WITH A POSSESSIVE. The edge is `silicon probe --part-of--> shank`, which asserts that the probe is part of the shank. The span says 'a multisite SHANK OF A SILICON PROBE' - the shank belongs to the probe. Found by TOOLS/audit_attribute_edges.py, built on the prediction that this class WOULD be lexically findable, unlike the common-cause class (Q-349): here the span states the relation possessively, so a matcher can see it. The prediction held - the signature catches both seed cases exactly - but the live population is only 10 edges, 3 without an effect cue. WHAT THE SPAN DOES SAY (Q-309): the containment, the right way round - AND IT COULD NOT BE RE-ADDED. The gate requires a containment cue for `part-of` (within / part of / comprises / consists of / includes / belongs to) and this span offers only a bare possessive. BARE `of` CANNOT BE A CONTAINMENT CUE - 'the amplitude OF the VAN' is possession of an attribute, 'the study OF memory' is aboutness - and that ambiguity is what produced this defect class in the first place. So the gate declined to let me repair the bug using the ambiguity that caused it, which is the rule working exactly as intended. Retracted without replacement; a better span may exist elsewhere in the paper and is left for the re-grounding pass. — strength of the relation: 1
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
